data:
Decision: NO-GO. Win probability: 1.9%.

Top drivers of low probability (SHAP): (1) Low expected evaluation score (est. 63.6) is the dominant negative—unlikely to be competitive on technical/commercial scoring. (2) Limited response time (240 hrs) slightly reduces chances—insufficient time to materially improve solution, staffing evidence, and packaging. (3) Budget sizing (PKR 150M; log 5.017) is a minor negative—tight economics vs. 24x7 SOC + MDR scope may constrain a strong offer.

Mandatory gaps and what it takes to close: (1) Financial eligibility: must evidence average annual turnover ≥ PKR 1,200M over last 3 audited years—requires audited financial statements meeting threshold or an eligible JV/consortium/prime-sub arrangement where the qualifying entity is the bidder per RFP rules. (2) Certified tier coverage: SOC team must include CISSP/GIAC (or equivalent) across all three tiers—requires named resources, valid certificates, role-to-tier mapping, and committed availability (LOIs/HR undertakings).

Recommendation: Maintain NO-GO unless we can legally qualify via a high-turnover bidding entity and lock certified Tier 1–3 staff immediately.
